newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-GOELLNER TO FACE CORRETJA IN MARBELLA FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GOELLNER TO FACE CORRETJA IN MARBELLA FINAL.

text.p: Unseeded German Marc Goellner seeks his fifth successive win over Spanish players when he faces fourth seed Alex Corretja in the Marbella world series men's tennis final on Sunday.
In Saturday's semifinals the unfancied Goellner scored another upset as he outlasted second seed Felix Mantilla in a three-set victory.
With both players relying on their baseline game Goellner took the first set 7-5, but Mantilla fought back to break in the last game of the second set, which he won 6-3.
Goellner used his powerful serve to clock up nine aces in total, and was able to wear down the Spaniard to run out a 6-3 winner in the final set.
Alex Corretja, who lost a memorable five-setter against Pete Sampras in the U.S. Open last month, never looked in trouble against another German, Bernd Karbacher, and took the match 6-4 6-4.
Goellner has faced Corretja twice, winning on both occasions.
